name: Encounter Resources Limited
summary: Encounter Resources Limited engages in the exploration and development of mineral deposits in Australia. The company explores for zinc, copper, gold, and cobalt deposits. It holds exploration tenure covering approximately 1,600 square kilometers of the Paterson Province; and exploration tenure in the Tanami region in Western Australia. The company also holds interests in the Elliott copper project covering an area of 4,500 square kilometers; and Jessica copper project covering an area of 5,500 square kilometers located in the Northern Territory of Australia. Encounter Resources Limited was founded in 2004 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.
